hero.headline: Manage AI Tool Configs Like a Pro
hero.subheadline: Baton DX is a CLI package manager for Developer Experience & AI configuration. Version, share, and sync AI tool configs across 14 tools with a single command.

features.title: Everything you need to manage AI configs
features.versioned_profiles_desc: Store configs in Git repos or npm packages. Track changes, rollback anytime.
features.tools_desc: Supports Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Zed, and 9 more AI coding tools.
features.merge_desc: Replace, deep-merge, append, prepend, skip, prompt, directory, or import. Full control.
features.scope_desc: Apply configs per-project or globally. Profiles compose and override cleanly.

how_it_works.title: Get started in 3 steps
how_it_works.step1_desc: Install the CLI globally with npm, Homebrew, or your preferred package manager.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Point Baton to a Git repo or npm package containing your AI tool configurations.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Run baton sync to pull profiles into your project or home directory.

cta.title: Start managing your AI configs today
cta.desc: Join developers who use Baton DX to keep their AI tools in sync.

footer.tagline: CLI package manager for AI tool configs.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.headline: Discover Community Profiles
marketplace.desc: Browse and share Baton profiles from the community. Find ready-made AI tool configurations for your workflow.
marketplace.notify_desc: Be the first to know when the Baton DX Marketplace opens.
